title: Metacognitive Myopia in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper proposes a theoretical framework (metacognitive myopia) to explain various biases in LLMs, including moral and social biases. While it discusses moral bias as a symptom and includes a section on future ethical research avenues, it does not conduct an evaluation or benchmarking of religious, moral, or ethical systems themselves; rather, it provides a psychological explanation for the existence of such biases.
